caption: The drawing shows a single piece of furniture, specifically a wooden cabinet or sideboard with a concave central section. The cabinet consists of three main sections: two straight, rectangular side sections with veneered wood panels, and a central, curved section featuring a lighter, vertically pleated or draped panel. The wood is rendered in shades of reddish-brown and dark brown, with visible wood grain patterns. Each section is bordered by molding, and the side sections have vertical, fluted pilasters with carved decorative capitals at the corners. The top surface of the cabinet is flat and follows the contours of the overall shape, including the curve in the center and angles at the sides. The overall design is symmetrical and rests on a plain, off-white background. There is a signature in the lower right corner of the image.
